knowledge_gaps: The proposed readout overlaps with established short-term-interest and gated sequential recommenders. Originality remains provisional until direct comparisons with relevant prior work are provided; time-aware GRU references do not directly support this item-conditioned readout.

A gate bias of -4 does not guarantee behavior close to the baseline: the projected item features may have a different scale. Report branch norms, gate distributions and initialization details. The latest-item branch may learn a transition shortcut rather than improve current-intent representation.

The comparisons isolate the gated extension only under BPR-max. A baseline-objective-plus-gate arm would distinguish a general readout benefit from an interaction with the ranking objective. Preserve identical shared-parameter initialization and control model randomness as well as sampler randomness.

Reproduction still requires the actual baseline reduction, score transformation, negative-scoring implementation, checkpoint-selection rule and numerical padding checks. Historical combined_score values should be confirmed as comparable pinned macro HR@10 measurements before drawing conclusions.

K=128 negatives per valid timestep can create substantial embedding and autograd memory costs. No concrete runtime allocation or affordable trial count is supplied for the shared GPU budget. Difficulty 4 and potential 7 are provisional estimates rather than demonstrated properties.
